purpose: Render an exact versioned DDN project asset read-only with navigation, export and presentation behavior owned by the public DDN viewer API.
navigation_model: DDN viewer owns diagram navigation while the host owns the workbench tab and window.

states.default: The validated DDN snapshot is displayed read-only.
states.loading: The workbench retains asset identity while the DDN library loads.
states.empty: A valid empty DDN workspace remains a navigable empty canvas.
states.error: Library, version or snapshot validation failure is explicit and non-destructive.
states.permission: Viewer access never exposes designer mutation commands.
states.disconnected_or_stale: The saved asset version remains viewable and is marked stale when authority refresh fails.

keyboard: DDN public keyboard handling remains inside the library; host tab, export and presentation commands remain reachable.
pointer: Pan/zoom/select use DDN public behavior; host detach and commands remain outside the DDN shadow boundary.
persistence: Viewer never persists rendered SVG, scene geometry or selection as a second model.
multi_window: Viewer is detachable, duplicable and presentation-capable through ToolDescriptor/WorkspaceHost.
accessibility: The hosting surface is named; library diagnostics are relayed to shared Problems.
